title: Graphs, paths, rooted trees, and König's lemma
proposed_reference_coverage: **Graphs and paths: connectedness, cycles, and trees**; **Rooted trees: levels, branches, and König's lemma**
fact_or_context_to_reference: Finite words ordered by prefix have one predecessor at every shorter length; infinite binary sequences correspond exactly to cofinal branches; a height-omega tree with finite levels has a cofinal branch. The rooted-graph treatment concerns finite-word trees and infinite rays, while general transfinite order trees can have several roots and limit-height nodes without immediate predecessors.
